name: Tormented Shadow

values.binNote: Wiki's 'minimum' per-tick value (9 to 35, +10% AP) is exactly half of the bin's MorganaW.BaseDamage/BaseAPRatio ([18..70], 0.2xap), which is what MorganaW#TotalMinDamage computes. The bin calculation named 'TotalMinDamage' therefore numerically matches the wiki's MAXIMUM tick value, not the minimum; the wiki's minimum appears to be BaseDamage halved (i.e. 0% missing-health case) which has no dedicated bin row.

MorganaW#TotalMinDamage (BaseDamage+0.2xap) equals this 'maximum per tick' value at full missing health per MorganaW.MissingHealthAmpPercent=1 (100%); see w_1 for the naming disagreement with the wiki's 'minimum' label.

mechanics.claim: Damage lands on-cast and then every 0.5 seconds while the zone persists.
mechanics.quote: Enemies within take {{as|magic damage}} on-cast and every {{fd|0.5}} seconds thereafter

mechanics.claim: Tick damage scales up the more missing health the target has, up to double damage at 100% missing health.
mechanics.quote: increased by {{pp|type=target's '''missing''' health|key=%|key1=%|0 to 100 for 11|0 to 100|formula=1% per 1% of target's '''missing''' health}}|health}}

mechanics.claim: Damage from multiple overlapping casts of Tormented Shadow does not stack.
mechanics.quote: Damage from multiple ''Tormented Shadows'' does not stack.

mechanics.claim: Tormented Shadow's own damage ticks trigger Soul Siphon, which reduces the ability's current cooldown by 5% of its total cooldown per trigger, and simultaneous triggers stack.
mechanics.quote: ''Tormented Shadow's'' {{sti|'''current''' cooldown}} is reduced by 5% of its '''total''' cooldown whenever ''{{ai|Soul Siphon|Morgana}}'' triggers. Simultaneous triggers from multiple targets will stack the cooldown reduction.

mechanics.claim: Tormented Shadow deals bonus damage against monsters.
